findings.description: The cycle-detection guard (`seen` set) was removed from the `__cause__` chain walk, so the loop can now run forever if the chain contains a cycle.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a retried function raises an exception whose `__cause__` chain loops back on itself, e.g. `a.__cause__ = b; b.__cause__ = a`, and no exception in the chain matches `exception_cause_types`. The loop `while exc is not None` then never reaches None, so the retry predicate never returns and the caller hangs at 100% CPU instead of retrying or raising.
